governing_rules: PRD §15: implement thresholds as configuration, not hard-coded literals. The engine reads this file; no numeric cutoff may live in code.
PRD §34: do not invent scoring logic, domain labels, diagnostic conclusions, product recommendations, continuation routing, consent assumptions, or CRM fields not specified in the PRD.

companion_libraries.narratives: SFL_narratives-v1.0.json (approved participant-facing copy; this config stores keys and thresholds only, never copy)
companion_libraries.connection_statements: SFL_connection-statements-v1.0.json (18 keys; tension codes here must match exactly)

_notes: Each major block carries a prd_section citing its source. Every numeric value the PRD does not state explicitly carries _calibration_status ASSUMED_PENDING_OPERATOR_REVIEW and is consolidated in calibration_assumptions for pre-launch calibration.

directional_scale._notes: Internal-only 1-5 directional values. Never exposed to participants (vocabulary rule).

option_value_maps._notes: A-to-E options read low-to-high throughout §9. Q11_A and Q12_F carry no numeric value (capacity overrides). Q11 B-E = 2-5 preserves absolute scale position and aligns with assessment-v1.0.json scoring_behavior capacity_override_first_else_2_5; flagged as interpretation in calibration_assumptions.

signals._notes: Formulas expressed as data (question lists + aggregation). Participant labels are the working §20.1 labels; internal construct names are unchanged. State copy lives in SFL_narratives-v1.0.json under the narrative_key shown; only keys, bands, and attention areas are stored here. All S1-S5 bands are ASSUMED (spec gives no numeric cutoffs).

ROOM.context_rule: Q9 supplies explanatory context only and contributes no numeric value (PRD §13.2).

DIRECT.override_rule: Subject to capacity overrides (§13.4-§13.6); see overrides block. Overridden items contribute no numeric value.
DIRECT.narrative_source: Q10, Q11, Q12 with capacity overrides

AIM.context_rule: Q16 is destination context only and contributes no numeric value (PRD §13.2). Q18 carries the §13.7 capacity modifier (interpretive; does not change the numeric average).
AIM.narrative_source: Q17, Q18, Q19; Q16 context; Q18 capacity modifier

subsignals._notes: Question-to-subsignal mapping is derived from the §15 bottleneck definitions (Q23 strong/Q24 weak = analysis bottleneck; Q23+Q24 strong/Q25 weak = execution bottleneck), which imply Q23=intake, Q24=evaluation, Q25=follow-through. Flagged as derivation in calibration_assumptions.

overrides._notes: Capacity is never misread as low agency. Single-override mapping to DIRECT_CAPACITY_LIMITED is an interpretation (spec explicitly defines only the dual-override mapping); flagged accordingly.

Q11_A.effect: Q11 contributes no numeric value to Agency; Agency = mean(Q10, Q12) unless Q12 is also capacity-constrained.

Q12_F.effect: Q12 contributes no numeric value to Agency; Agency = mean(Q10, Q11) unless Q11 is also capacity-constrained.

BOTH_Q11_A_AND_Q12_F.effect: Agency is based on Q10 only. This is not missing data; both answers are substantive.
BOTH_Q11_A_AND_Q12_F.state_rule: Use DIRECT_LIMITED_EVIDENCE_CAPACITY rather than a low DIRECT state (approved narrative-library rule).

Q18_capacity_modifier._notes: Interpretive rule: changes narrative selection, not the Direction numeric average. Cutoffs assumed.
Q18_capacity_modifier.effect: Generate CLEAR_DESTINATION_CAPACITY_CONSTRAINED_ALIGNMENT rather than low-direction language; prefer AIM_CAPACITY_CONSTRAINED_ALIGNMENT as the AIM signal state.

special_signal_states._notes: Keys resolve copy in SFL_narratives-v1.0.json SPECIAL.*.

DIRECT_CAPACITY_LIMITED.label: Intentional — Capacity Constrained
DIRECT_CAPACITY_LIMITED.when: Single capacity override (Q11_A xor Q12_F). INTERPRETATION_PENDING_OPERATOR_REVIEW.

DIRECT_LIMITED_EVIDENCE_CAPACITY.label: Intentionality — Limited Evidence
DIRECT_LIMITED_EVIDENCE_CAPACITY.when: Q11_A and Q12_F both trigger; use rather than a low DIRECT state (explicit approved-library rule).

AIM_CAPACITY_CONSTRAINED_ALIGNMENT.label: Clear Direction — Limited Room to Act
AIM_CAPACITY_CONSTRAINED_ALIGNMENT.when: Direction clear, Q18 alignment low, Capacity constrained (§13.7 condition above).

classifiers._notes: Each tag fires on selection of its option. Q9 contributes context tags only (no numeric value). Q9_L and Q21_G are exclusive. Q1_G and Q16_J are explicitly NOT exclusive.

Q9_capacity_context.exclusive_note: Q9_L ('I don't usually feel financially stretched') may not coexist with any other Q9 option. Q9_M permits open text and still emits OTHER_PRESSURE.

Q16_destination.exclusive_note: Q16_J ('still figuring out') is not exclusive per §14. Q16_K permits open text and still emits OTHER_DESTINATION.

Q21_fear_friction.exclusive_note: Q21_G ('None of these usually stop me') may not coexist with any other Q21 option. Q21_H permits open text and still emits OTHER_FEAR_FRICTION.

fear_present_definition._notes: Interpretation: any Q21 selection other than exclusive Q21_G counts as fear present for HIGH_FEAR_HIGH_ACTIVATION. Whether Q21_H ('something else') counts is flagged in open_questions.

tension_thresholds._prd_section: §15 ('Thresholds for high/low remain provisional in MVP v1.0')
tension_thresholds._notes: Every value here is ASSUMED and exists so pilot calibration can change it without rewriting the engine.

capacity_low._note: Harmonised with signal_low (<= 2.59). Was 'None', which left a Capacity mean in (2.5, 2.59] classified as S2 'Limited Room' by the band table but NOT counted as capacity_low by the tension engine — so HIGH_DIRECTION_LOW_CAPACITY and the §13.7 Q18 modifier would not fire for a participant the report calls capacity-limited.

pair_low_avg.meaning: low at two-item average level (used for Q4/Q5 and Q13/Q15 pairs)

tensions._notes: 16 cross-domain tensions from §15 plus the §13.7 capacity-constrained-alignment code and the §18.3 null-finding code = 18 codes, matching the 18 keys of SFL_connection-statements-v1.0.json exactly. Each connection_key resolves copy in that library. All high/low cutoffs reference tension_thresholds (assumed).

INFORMATION_OVERLOAD_PATTERN._trigger_note: PRD §15 verbatim: 'Q23 weak, Q24 weak, Q25 weak and/or Q21 information-overload tag.' Reads as (all three weak) OR (tag present). The prior encoding placed the three-item list inside the outer `any` with ALL semantics, so a SINGLE weak item plus no tag fired the tension — materially wider than the spec. Corrected to require all three.

SUPPORT_OPENNESS_AGENCY_VULNERABILITY.handling_note: Reinforce informed decision-making and participant ownership (PRD §15).

PRIVACY_AVOIDANCE_FRICTION.handling_note: Phrase as 'may be interacting with avoidance' (PRD §15).

NO_MEANINGFUL_FRICTION_IDENTIFIED.provenance: PRD §18.3 null finding (surfaced as a connection statement)

null_finding.rule: The engine must be able to return NO_MEANINGFUL_FRICTION_IDENTIFIED and must not invent a weakness.

operationalization._notes: Operator-approved 2026-10-01 (Option 2). PRD §29 requires 'strong consistent evidence across all operating signals'; S3 alone is the DEVELOPING band ('Coming Into Focus', 'Developing Direction'), so all-S3 is not strong evidence. The gate therefore needs BOTH a floor (every signal at least S3) AND corroboration (enough signals actually at S4+). An all-S3 profile must produce neither a null finding nor a manufactured friction finding — it is a distinct third outcome.
operationalization.condition: No other tension triggered AND every operating signal at S3 or above AND at least min_signals_s4_or_above signals at S4 or above AND no meaningful contextual friction.
operationalization._corroboration_note: 3 of 6 chosen so a simple majority must be genuinely clear. Two S4s among four developing areas reads as 'mostly still developing', which is the case the operator explicitly wants distinguishable from a real all-clear. Calibratable.

null_finding.acceptance_anchor: PRD §29 null-finding test: strong consistent evidence across all signals with no meaningful contextual friction.
null_finding.attention_area_note: Library area KEEP_OBSERVING ('Your responses do not support inventing a problem…') was referenced nowhere. It is the natural match for the null finding, and PRD §18.3 forbids manufacturing friction the responses do not support.

language_strength._notes: Copy strings are verbatim from the spec and the approved vocabulary library. The evidence-confidence band selecting each level is not specified numerically; bands below are ASSUMED.

HIGH.evidence_confidence_band: Strong corroborated evidence (e.g. extreme signal state S1/S5 with 2+ corroborating items or tensions).

MODERATE.evidence_confidence_band: Single-signal or partially corroborated evidence (e.g. S2/S4 states).

LIMITED.evidence_confidence_band: Override-constrained, single-item, or classifier-only contextual evidence.

derivation._notes: Operationalizes the three prose bands above into a deterministic, config-driven rule (PRD §15: thresholds as configuration, never hard-coded literals). The spec states the three tiers and the language each selects, but specifies NO numeric derivation — every value here is ASSUMED and must be calibrated during pilot. Read by lib/assessment/evidence-chain.ts deriveEvidenceConfidence(). Changing these values changes engine behaviour with no code change.
derivation._rule: HIGH  = ladder state is an extreme_states member AND corroboration >= strong_corroboration_min. MODERATE = ladder state is a non-middle, non-extreme state (S2/S4), OR corroboration >= moderate_corroboration_min. LIMITED = a special (override) state applies, OR neither of the above holds.

structural_separation._notes: Never average A1-A4 into a single motivation score. Activation never changes diagnosis (§17). This is a structural property: no combined field exists in this config for the engine to read.

A4.name: Support Readiness
A4.safeguard: Support Readiness means openness to exploring support under acceptable conditions. It is not appointment consent, marketing consent, agreement to work with a professional, or purchase intent (§11). Low A4 is a preference, not financial friction (§17).

level_bands._notes: Not specified numerically; bands assumed for pattern detection and pilot calibration.

activation.low_state_notes: Low urgency is a legitimate state; do not manufacture urgency. Low support readiness is a preference, not financial friction (§17).

perception_gap._notes: Outcomes are specified; the numeric comparison method is not. Gating rule is explicit; comparison function is an open question.
perception_gap.gating_rule: Opening B must be interpreted only after Q16 is known; Q16 defines what 'Set for Life' means to that participant.
perception_gap.handling_note: Never tell the participant they are wrong about themselves.

friction_precedence._notes: Qualitative rules, encoded as stated. No numeric thresholds involved.
rules: Very low Capacity + moderate/high Agency: investigate Capacity before Agency.
Very low Visibility: be cautious about strong spending/intentionality conclusions.
High Direction + low Alignment + low Capacity: capacity-constrained alignment, not Direction friction.
Q23/Q24 high + Q25 low: execution friction, not education friction.
Q23/Q24 low: overload/analysis may precede execution.
Q21 fear + strong behavior: fear exists but may not be major friction.
Privacy + strong Visibility/Agency/Professional Agency: no Openness friction.
Low A4: do not classify as financial friction.
friction_precedence.primary_vs_secondary: Primary friction best explains multiple downstream difficulties; secondary is partly downstream of another factor; independent friction is meaningful but not explained by the primary. Do not simply select the lowest numeric domain (§18.2).

calibration_assumptions.rationale: Equal-interval partition of the 1-5 continuum aligned to §13.1 anchors; boundaries avoid exact hits for 3-item averages.
Mirrors §13.1 anchors (4 = relative strength, 2 = meaningful friction).

calibration_assumptions.threshold: Signal-level HIGH = S4-S5 (mean >= 3.40); LOW = S1-S2 (mean <= 2.59); capacity_low = mean <= 2.5; pair-low avg <= 2.5
calibration_assumptions.rationale: Derives tension-level high/low from the assumed state bands so one calibration change propagates.

calibration_assumptions.threshold: Q11 non-override options B-E = 2-5 (A = null + override)
calibration_assumptions.rationale: Preserves absolute scale position; aligns with assessment-v1.0.json scoring_behavior capacity_override_first_else_2_5.
Derived from §15 bottleneck definitions, which imply intake -> evaluation -> follow-through order.

calibration_assumptions.threshold: Q18 modifier: clarity mean(Q17,Q19) >= 4.0, Q18 <= 2, Capacity <= 2.5
calibration_assumptions.rationale: Operationalizes §13.7 'high / low / low' with item_high, item_low, and capacity_low.

calibration_assumptions.threshold: Single override (Q11_A xor Q12_F) surfaces DIRECT_CAPACITY_LIMITED
calibration_assumptions.rationale: Spec explicitly maps only the dual case; this extends the approved SPECIAL state symmetrically. Requires operator confirmation.

calibration_assumptions.threshold: fear_present = any Q21 selection except exclusive Q21_G (includes Q21_H)
calibration_assumptions.rationale: Q21_H ('something else') indicates something did impede a decision; operator to confirm.

calibration_assumptions.threshold: Privacy tensions: Q20 limited = value <= 2; Q6 avoidance/strength = <= 2 / >= 4; Q22 low/strong = <= 2 / >= 4; HIGH_CONFIDENCE_LOW_VISIBILITY pair avg(Q4,Q5) <= 2.5; PREPAREDNESS pair avg(Q13,Q15) <= 2.5
calibration_assumptions.rationale: Item_high/item_low/pair_low_avg applied to the §15 prose; operator may widen Q20 avoidance to <= 3.

calibration_assumptions.threshold: Activation LOW = A/B, MID = C, HIGH = D/E
calibration_assumptions.rationale: Standard 5-point collapse; aligns with vocabulary LOW/MID/HIGH activation copy.

calibration_assumptions.threshold: Language-strength evidence bands (HIGH = extreme state + corroboration; MODERATE = single-signal; LIMITED = override/single-item/classifier-only)
calibration_assumptions.rationale: Provisional mapping so copy selection is deterministic; needs operator + pilot review.

calibration_assumptions.threshold: Null finding operationalized as: no other tension triggered AND all signals >= S3 AND no meaningful contextual friction
calibration_assumptions.rationale: Encodes §29 acceptance test ('strong consistent evidence, no meaningful contextual friction') as a checkable gate.

open_questions: O1: Confirm S1-S5 band boundaries (A1) and tension high/low cutoffs (A2-A3, A9) before launch; pilot data should recalibrate.
O2: Confirm Q11 B-E = 2-5 mapping (A4) versus renormalized 1-4.
O4: Confirm Q21_H counts as fear_present (A8).
O5: Specify the Perception Gap comparison function (OPEN_B 1-5 vs profile) - no numeric method in spec.
O6: Confirm null-finding gate (A12): should S3-minimum hold, or require all signals >= S4?

comparator_semantics._note: List semantics for tension triggers. These were previously undefined, which left six triggers ambiguous between ALL and ANY.
comparator_semantics.item_gte: ALL named items must be >= the referenced threshold.
comparator_semantics.item_lte: ALL named items must be <= the referenced threshold.
comparator_semantics.avg_lte: MEAN of the named items must be <= the inline `value`.
comparator_semantics.signal: The named signal's state must be in `state_in`.
comparator_semantics.tag_present: The named classifier tag must be present.
comparator_semantics.tag_absent: NONE of the named tags may be present.
comparator_semantics.any_tag_present: AT LEAST ONE of the named tags must be present.
comparator_semantics.fear_present: Any Q21 selection other than exclusive Q21_G (see classifiers.Q21_fear_friction).
comparator_semantics.activation_high: ALL named activation items are HIGH.
comparator_semantics.any_activation_high: AT LEAST ONE named activation item is HIGH.
comparator_semantics.any: At least one child condition must hold.

tension_precedence._note:
PRD §15 defines these two tensions with effectively identical conditions:
  HIGH_INFORMATION_LOW_ACTION:    'Q23/Q24 relatively strong with Q25 weak.'
  INFORMATION_EXECUTION_BOTTLENECK: 'Q23 and Q24 relatively strong, Q25 weak.'
Both therefore fire on the same answers. The spec states no distinction, so this precedence is an ASSUMED tie-break, not spec text — operator must confirm.
tension_precedence.rationale: The Snapshot renders ONE prominent Connection Statement. EXECUTION_BOTTLENECK is the more specific description of the same pattern (the participant can evaluate information but does not act on it), whereas HIGH_INFORMATION_LOW_ACTION is the broader framing. Both codes remain stored in `tensions` for the evidence chain; only the rendered statement is de-duplicated.
